purpose: Business-repository automatic event acceptance on a synthetic PR; not review quality evaluation.

automatic_preview.trigger_evidence: PR timeline ready_for_review immediately precedes the automatic run; no workflow_dispatch used.

findings.title: mean_chunk_score raises ZeroDivisionError on empty input despite documented 0.0 contract
findings.explanation: The new function `mean_chunk_score` documents in its own docstring (line 5) that "an empty list should produce 0.0", but the implementation on line 6 computes `sum(scores) / len(scores)`. When `scores` is empty, `len(scores)` is 0, so the division raises `ZeroDivisionError` instead of returning the documented 0.0. The documented behavior and the actual behavior directly contradict each other, so any caller relying on the stated contract (e.g. aggregating scores over a chunk set that may be empty) will crash rather than receive 0.0. The fix is to guard the empty case, e.g. `return sum(scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0.0`.
findings.trigger: Call `mean_chunk_score([])` (or pass any empty sequence of scores).
